item.title: Design Nearby Friends
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: 333,000 location updates a second turn into 13.3 million messages a second. Why moving people are a completely different problem from static businesses — WebSocket fan-out, Redis Pub/Sub as a routing layer, and an interactive calculator for the amplification that decides the whole design.
